name: Victorious: Taking the Lead
source: Sikowitz is holding a musical adaptation of Romeo and Juliet, with Tori and Jade both competing for the role of Juliet. The player can either choose to play as Tori or Jade. [Edited from [url=https://victorious.fandom.com/wiki/Victorious:_Taking_The_Lead]Victorious Wiki[/url]]
